notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is incorrect for return-trip Mozio tickets in the email confirmation. The mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch function passes discount.amount through without any return-trip adjustment, while create-reservations.mappers.ts already applies return-trip-specific logic (e.g. swapping stations). The discount amount likely needs analogous return-trip handling so the email confirmation displays the correct promo code value.

notes: Openspec provided no acceptance criteria (empty array) but identified the root cause: mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch passes discount.amount through without return-trip adjustment. I created all 7 ACs from scratch based on the defect description and openspec's root-cause analysis. AC-1 is the core fix verification. AC-2 guards against regression on outbound trips. AC-3 covers the no-promo-code edge case. AC-4 and AC-5 cover the two sub-cases of differing vs. same discounts across legs. AC-6 covers a zero-discount edge case. AC-7 ensures end-to-end consistency between the data mapping layer and the email output, addressing the specific function openspec flagged.
